news.title: Australian regulators raise compliance concerns over agent commission ban
news.summary_en: Australia’s higher education and vocational education regulators have issued a joint sector alert warning providers over practices that may undermine a ban on education agent commissions linked to onshore overseas student transfers.
news.author: Kim Martin

news.title: Made Impact aims to “change the narrative” with UN summit
news.summary_en: The inaugural Made Impact Summit 2026 will take place at the United Nations in New York, it has been confirmed.
news.author: Nicholas Cuthbert

news.title: White House proposal to “dramatically weaken” US research, experts warn
news.summary_en: US higher education leaders are calling on Congress to reject a Trump administration proposal to hand political appointees control over federal grantmaking, potentially impacting $1.1 trillion in funding.
news.author: Polly Nash

news.title: UK unis must pivot towards partnerships as China market evolves
news.summary_en: UK universities must move beyond viewing China as a recruitment market and instead build deeper strategic partnerships if they are to remain competitive, delegates heard at the British Universities China Association's (BUCA) ninth annual conference.
news.author: Rongrong Walker

news.title: Every 10 international students generate £1m for UK economy
news.summary_en: International students represent a major economic benefit to the UK, generating billions during their time in the country, a new report has found.
news.author: Beth Kennedy

news.title: Erasmus+ to replace Turing and Taith as sector calls for best of both
news.summary_en: As the UK winds down Turing and Taith in favour of a more generously funded Erasmus+, stakeholders say the transition must preserve the former schemes' successes.
news.author: Polly Nash
